The people said: 'We have never seen or heard of a king to whom God has given such rule, wisdom, knowledge, and management as He has given this king.' Then Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to the King: 'O King, what is your view regarding the dominion over Egypt and its surroundings that my Lord has entrusted to me? Is it, in your opinion, a source of harm for us? For I did not reform them only to corrupt them, nor did I save them from the calamity only to become a calamity upon them; rather, it was God Almighty who saved them through my hands.' The King said: 'The decision is yours.' Yusuf (peace be upon him) said: 'I call God to witness, and I call you to witness, O King, that I have emancipated all the people of Egypt, and I have returned to them their wealth and their slaves. And I return to you, O King, your ring, your throne, and your crown, on the condition that you do not rule except by my way and do not judge except by my judgment.' The King said to him: 'It is my pride and my honor that I do not rule except by your way and do not judge except by your judgment. If not for you, I would not have had the strength for this, nor would I have been guided to it. You have made my authority mighty and unassailable. I bear witness that there is no god but God alone, with no partner, and that you are His messenger. So, continue in the position I have entrusted to you, for you are with us established and trustworthy.'"
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 92

57.ar: عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِیَاثٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: کَانَ سِنِینُ یُوسُفَ الْغَلَاءَ الَّذِی أَصَابَ النَّاسَ وَ لَمْ یُتَمَنَ الْغَلَاءَ لِأَحَدٍ قَطُّ قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ التُّجَّارُ فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا قَالَ اشْتَرُوا فَقَالُوا نَأْخُذُ کَذَا بِکَذَا فَقَالَ خُذُوا وَ أَمَرَ فَکَالُوهُمْ فَحَمَلُوا وَ مَضَوْا حَتَّی دَخَلُوا الْمَدِینَةَ فَلَقِیَهُمْ قَوْمٌ تُجَّارٌ فَقَالُوا لَهُمْ کَیْفَ أَخَذْتُمْ فَقَالُوا کَذَا بِکَذَا وَ أَضْعَفُوا الثَّمَنَ قَالَ فَقَدِمُوا أُولَئِکَ عَلَی یُوسُفَ فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا فَقَالَ اشْتَرُوا کَیْفَ تَأْخُذُونَ فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا کَمَا بِعْتَ کَذَا بِکَذَا فَقَالَ مَا هُوَ کَمَا تَقُولُونَ وَ لَکِنْ خُذُوا فَأَخُذُوا ثُمَّ مَضَوْا حَتَّی دَخَلُوا الْمَدِینَةَ فَلَقِیَهُمْ آخَرُونَ فَقَالُوا کَیْفَ أَخَذْتُمْ فَقَالُوا کَذَا بِکَذَا وَ أَضْعَفُوا الثَّمَنَ قَالَ فَعَظُمَ النَّاسَ ذَلِکَ الْغَلَاءُ وَ قَالُوا اذْهَبُوا بِنَا حَتَّی نَشْتَرِیَ قَالَ فَذَهَبُوا إِلَی یُوسُفَ فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا فَقَالَ اشْتَرُوا فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا کَمَا بِعْتَ فَقَالَ وَ کَیْفَ بِعْتُ قَالُوا کَذَا بِکَذَا فَقَالَ مَا هُوَ کَذَلِکَ وَ لَکِنْ خُذُوا فَأَخُذُوا وَ رَجَعُوا إِلَی الْمَدِینَةِ فَأَخْبَرُوا النَّاسَ فَقَالُوا فِیمَا بَیْنَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا حَتَّی نَکْذِبَ فِی الرَّخْصِ کَمَا کَذَبْنَا فِی الْغَلَاءِ قَالَ فَذَهَبُوا إِلَی یُوسُفَ فَقَالُوا لَهُ بِعْنَا فَقَالَ اشْتَرُوا فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا کَمَا بِعْتَ قَالَ وَ کَیْفَ بِعْتُ قَالُوا کَذَا بِکَذَا بِالْحَطِّ مِنَ السِّعْرِ الْأَوَّلِ فَقَالَ مَا هُوَ کَذَا وَ لَکِنْ خُذُوا قَالَ فَأَخُذُوا وَ ذَهَبُوا إِلَی الْمَدِینَةِ فَلَقِیَهُمْ النَّاسُ فَسَأَلُوهُمْ بِکَمِ اشْتَرَیْتُمْ فَقَالُوا کَذَا بِکَذَا بِنِصْفِ الْحَطِّ الْأَوَّلِ فَقَالَ الْآخَرُونَ اذْهَبُوا بِنَا حَتَّی نَشْتَرِیَ فَذَهَبُوا إِلَی یُوسُفَ فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا فَقَالَ اشْتَرُوا فَقَالُوا بِعْنَا کَمَا بِعْتَ فَقَالَ وَ کَیْفَ بِعْتُ فَقَالُوا کَذَا بِکَذَا بِالْحَطِّ مِنَ النِّصْفِ فَقَالَ مَا هُوَ کَمَا تَقُولُونَ وَ لَکِنْ خُذُوا فَلَمْ یَزَالُوا یَتَکَاذَبُونَ حَتَّی رَجَعَ السِّعْرُ إِلَی الْأَمْرِ الْأَوَّلِ کَمَا أَرَادَ اللَّه.
57.fa: حفص‌بن‌غیاث نقل می‌کند که امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: «یوسف (علیه السلام) بر گرانی‌ای که مردم به آن دچار شدند، پیشی گرفت و گرانی را هرگز برای هیچ‌کس نخواست». حضرت فرمود: «بازرگانان نزد او آمدند و گفتند: «به ما [آذوقه] بفروش». یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «بخرید»! آنان گفتند «ما فلان مقدار را به فلان قیمت می‌خریم». یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «بخرید و دستور داد تا برایشان پیمانه کنند. آنان آن مقدار را برداشتند و رفتند تا اینکه وارد شهر شدند». گروهی از بازرگانان به آنان برخوردند و پرسیدند: «چگونه خریدید»؟ آنان پاسخ دادند: «فلان مقدار را به فلان قیمت خریدیم». و قیمت را چند برابر کردند. حضرت فرمود: «آنان بر یوسف (علیه السلام) وارد شدند و گفتند: «به ما بفروش». یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «بخرید، چگونه می‌خرید». گفتند: «بفروش! همچنان‌که فلان مقدار را به فلان قیمت فروختی»! یوسف فرمود: «آن‌طور که می‌گویند نیست. امّا بخرید». آنان خریدند سپس رفتند تا اینکه وارد شهر شدند، گروه دیگری به آنان برخوردند و پرسیدند: «چگونه خریدید»؟ آنان پاسخ دادند: «فلان مقدار را به فلان قیمت»! و قیمت را چند برابر کردند. حضرت فرمود: «مردم آن قیمت را زیاد دانستند». و گفتند: «بیایید برویم و بخریم»! حضرت فرمود: «آنان به‌سوی یوسف (علیه السلام) رفتند و گفتند: به ما [نیز] بفروش»! یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «بخرید»! آنان گفتند: «به ما بفروش همان‌طور که فروختی». یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «آن‌طور که می‌گویید نیست، امّا بخرید». حضرت فرمود: «آنان خریدند و به شهر بازگشتند. آنان مردم را باخبر کردند و با خودشان گفتند که بیایید تا قیمت را به دروغ ارزان کنیم، همان‌طور که به دروغ گران کردیم». حضرت فرمود: آنان نزد یوسف (علیه السلام) آمدند و گفتند: «به ما بفروش»! یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «بخرید». آنان گفتند همان‌طور که فروختی بفروش». یوسف (علیه السلام) پرسید: «من چگونه فروختم»! آنان پاسخ دادند: «فلان مقدار به فلان قیمت». و از قیمت اوّل کاستند. یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «این‌طور که می‌گویید نیست، امّا بخرید». حضرت فرمود: «آنان خریدند و به شهر رفتند». مردم به آنان برخوردند و از آنان پرسیدند: «به چه قیمتی خریدید»؟ آنان پاسخ دادند: «فلان مقدار به فلان قیمت». به نصف قیمت اوّل. دیگران گفتند: «بیایید برویم تا بخریم». آنان نزد یوسف (علیه السلام) آمدند و گفتند: «بفروش» یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «بخرید». آنان گفتند: «همان‌طور که فروختی بفروش». یوسف (علیه السلام) پرسید: «من چگونه فروختم»؟ آنان پاسخ دادند: «فلان مقدار به فلان قیمت». و از آن نصف نیز کاستند. یوسف (علیه السلام) فرمود: «آن‌طور که می‌گویید نیست، امّا بخرید». آنان پیوسته به یکدیگر دروغ می‌گفتند تا آنکه قیمت همان‌طور که خداوند خواست به همان حالت اوّل بازگشت».
57.en: Hafs ibn Ghiyath narrates that Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: "Yusuf (peace be upon him) preceded the famine that afflicted the people, and he never desired famine for anyone at all." He said: "The merchants came to him and said, 'Sell to us.' He said, 'Buy.' They said, 'We will take such-and-such for such-and-such price.' He said, 'Take it,' and he ordered that it be measured for them. They loaded it and departed until they entered the city. A group of merchants met them and asked, 'How did you buy it?' They replied, 'For such-and-such price,' and they inflated the price. He said: "They came to Yusuf and said, 'Sell to us.' He said, 'Buy. How will you buy?' They said, 'Sell to us as you sold [before], such-and-such for such-and-such price.' He said, 'It is not as you say, but take it.' So they took it, then departed until they entered the city. Another group met them and asked, 'How did you buy it?' They replied, 'For such-and-such price,' and they inflated the price. He said: "The people found that price to be exorbitant, and they said, 'Let us go and buy.' He said: "They went to Yusuf and said, 'Sell to us.' He said, 'Buy.' They said, 'Sell to us as you sold [before].' He said, 'And how did I sell?' They said, 'Such-and-such for such-and-such price.' He said, 'It is not like that, but take it.' He said: "They bought it and returned to the city. They informed the people and said among themselves, 'Come, let us lie about the price being cheap, just as we lied about it being expensive.' He said: "They went to Yusuf and said to him, 'Sell to us.' He said, 'Buy.' They said, 'Sell to us as you sold [before].' He said, 'And how did I sell?' They said, 'Such-and-such for such-and-such price,' reducing the initial price. He said, 'It is not like that, but take it.' He said: "They took it and went to the city. The people met them and asked, 'At what price did you buy?' They replied, 'For such-and-such price,' at half the initial reduction. The others said, 'Let us go and buy.' They went to Yusuf and said, 'Sell to us.' He said, 'Buy.' They said, 'Sell to us as you sold [before].' He said, 'And how did I sell?' They said, 'Such-and-such for such-and-such price,' reducing it from the half. He said, 'It is not as you say, but take it.' They continued to lie to one another until the price returned to the original state, just as God willed."
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 94
57.refs: Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 13, p. 278; Al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

57.ar: لَمَّا صَارَتِ الْأَشْیَاءُ لِیُوسُفَ بْنِ یَعْقُوبَ (علیه السلام) جَعَلَ الطَّعَامَ فِی بُیُوتٍ وَ أَمَرَ بَعْضَ وُکَلَائِهِ فَکَانَ یَقُولُ بِعْ بِکَذَا وَ کَذَا وَ السِّعْرُ قَائِمٌ فَلَمَّا عَلِمَ أَنَّهُ یَزِیدُ فِی ذَلِکَ الْیَوْمِ کَرِهَ أَنْ یَجْرِیَ الْغَلَاءُ عَلَی لِسَانِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ اذْهَبْ فَبِعْ وَ لَمْ یُسَمِّ لَهُ سِعْراً فَذَهَبَ الْوَکِیلُ غَیْرَ بَعِیدٍ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَیْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ اذْهَبْ فَبِعْ وَ کَرِهَ أَنْ یَجْرِیَ الْغَلَاءُ عَلَی لِسَانِهِ فَذَهَبَ الْوَکِیلُ فَجَاءَ أَوَّلُ مَنِ اکْتَالَ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ دُونَ مَا کَانَ بِالْأَمْسِ بِمِکْیَالٍ قَالَ الْمُشْتَرِی حَسْبُکَ إِنَّمَا أَرَدْتُ بِکَذَا وَ کَذَا فَعَلِمَ الْوَکِیلُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ غَلَا بِمِکْیَالٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ آخَرُ فَقَالَ لَهُ کِلْ لِی فَکَالَ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ دُونَ الَّذِی کَالَ لِلْأَوَّلِ بِمِکْیَالٍ قَالَ لَهُ الْمُشْتَرِی حَسْبُکَ إِنَّمَا أَرَدْتُ بِکَذَا وَ کَذَا فَعَلِمَ الْوَکِیلُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ غَلَا بِمِکْیَالٍ حَتَّی صَارَ إِلَی وَاحِدٍ بِوَاحِدٍ.
57.fa: وقتی کارها به دست یوسف (علیه السلام) افتاد، مواد خوراکی را در خانه‌هایی قرار داده و به یکی از کارگزاران خود دستور داد آن‌ها را به قیمت ثابت و مشخّصی بفروشد. زمانی‌که یوسف (علیه السلام) متوجّه شد قیمت‌ها بالاتر می‌رود، چون نمی‌خواست سخن او باعث گرانی شود، از این‌رو [روز بعد] بدون آنکه سخنی از قیمت به میان بیاورد به کارگزار خود گفت: «برو بفروش». کارگزار اندکی دور شد و نزد یوسف (علیه السلام) بازگشت. [برای بار دوّم] یوسف (علیه السلام) به او گفت: برو بفروش». و نمی‌خواست سخنش باعث گرانی شود. سرانجام کارگزار رفت. اوّلین خریدار که آمد، هنگام اندازه‌گیریِ کالا وقتی مقدار آن به یک پیمانه کمتر از مقدار روز گذشته رسید. خریدار گفت: «کافی است! من همین مقدار در مقابل فلان مبلغ می‌خواستم». کارگزار فهمید که [آن کالا] به مقدار یک پیمانه گران‌تر شده است. کمی بعد، خریدار دیگری آمد و درخواست کالا کرد و کارگزار مشغول اندازه‌گیری شد؛ وقتی به یک پیمانه کمتر از مقداری که برای مشتری قبلی پیمانه کرده بود رسید. مشتری گفت: «کافی است! من همین مقدار در مقابل فلان مبلغ می‌خواستم. بازکارگزار فهمید که [آن کالا] به مقدار یک پیمانه گران‌تر شده است. [و این روند افزایش قیمت ادامه یافت] تا اینکه آن مبلغ با یک پیمانه از آن کالا برابر شد».
57.en: When matters came under the control of Yusuf ibn Ya'qub (peace be upon him), he placed the food in storehouses and instructed one of his agents, saying, "Sell it for such and such," while the price was established. When he realized that the price was increasing that day, he disliked that inflation should be spoken of by his tongue. So he said to him, "Go and sell," without specifying a price for him. The agent went a short distance, then returned to him. He said to him, "Go and sell," for he disliked that inflation should be spoken of by his tongue. The agent went away. The first person to come for measuring arrived, and when it reached one measure less than what it had been the previous day, the buyer said, "That is enough for you; I only wanted such and such [amount] for such and such [price]." The agent realized that it had become more expensive by one measure. Then another came to him and said, "Measure for me." He measured, and when it reached one measure less than what he had measured for the first customer, the buyer said to him, "That is enough for you; I only wanted such and such [amount] for such and such [price]." The agent realized that it had become more expensive by one measure, until it reached the point where one [measure] was [sold] for one [price].
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 96

57.ar: مَلَکَ یُوسُفُ مِصْرَ وَ بَرَارِیَهَا لَمْ یُجَاوِزْهَا إِلَی غَیْرِهَا.
57.fa: قلمروی حکومت یوسف (علیه السلام)، کشور مصر و صحراهای آن بود و از آن محدوده، خارج نبود.
57.en: Yusuf ruled over Egypt and its deserts; he did not extend beyond them to any other territory.
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 96
57.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 305; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

62.ar: وَ کَانَ بَیْنَهُ وَ بَیْنَ أَبِیهِ ثَمَانِیَةَ عَشَرَ یَوْماً وَ کَانَ فِی بَادِیَةٍ وَ کَانَ النَّاسُ مِنَ الْآفَاقِ یَخْرُجُونَ إِلَی مِصْرَ لِیَمْتَارُوا طَعَاماً وَ کَانَ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) وَ وُلْدُهُ نُزُولًا فِی بَادِیَةٍ فِیهِ مُقْلٌ فَأَخَذَ إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) مِنْ ذَلِکَ الْمُقْلِ وَ حَمَلُوهُ إِلَی مِصْرَ لِیَمْتَارُوا بِهِ طَعَاماً وَ کَانَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) یَتَوَلَّی الْبَیْعَ بِنَفْسِهِ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ إِخْوَتُهُ عَلَی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) عَرَفَهُمْ وَ لَمْ یَعْرِفُوهُ کَمَا حَکَی اللَّهُ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ هُمْ لَهُ مُنْکِرُونَ* فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمْ بِجَهَازِهِمْ وَ أَعْطَاهُمْ وَ أَحْسَنَ إِلَیْهِمْ فِی الْکَیْلِ قَالَ لَهُمْ مَنْ أَنْتُمْ قَالُوا نَحْنُ بَنُو یَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (علیه السلام) خَلِیلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِی أَلْقَاهُ نُمْرُودُ فِی النَّارِ فَلَمْ یَحْتَرِقْ فَجَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ بَرْداً وَ سَلَاماً قَالَ فَمَا فَعَلَ أَبُوکُمْ قَالُوا شَیْخٌ ضَعِیفٌ قَالَ فَلَکُمْ أَخٌ غَیْرُکُمْ قَالُوا لَنَا أَخٌ مِنْ أَبِینَا لَا مِنْ أُمِّنَا قَالَ فَإِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَیَّ فَأْتُوْنِی بِهِ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ ائْتُونِی بِأَخٍ لَکُمْ مِنْ أَبِیکُمْ أَ لا تَرَوْنَ أَنِّی أُوفِی الْکَیْلَ وَ أَنَا خَیْرُ الْمُنْزِلِینَ* فَإِنْ لَمْ تَأْتُونِی بِهِ فَلا کَیْلَ لَکُمْ عِنْدِی وَ لا تَقْرَبُونِ* قالُوا سَنُراوِدُ عَنْهُ أَباهُ وَ إِنَّا لَفاعِلُونَ ثُمَّ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) لِقَوْمِهِ رُدُّوا هَذِهِ الْبِضَاعَةَ الَّتِی حَمَلُوهَا إِلَیْنَا اجْعَلُوهَا فِیمَا بَیْنَ رِحَالِهِمْ حَتَّی إِذَا رَجَعُوا إِلَی مَنَازِلِهِمْ وَ رَأَوْهَا رَجَعُوا إِلَیْنَا وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ وَ قالَ لِفِتْیانِهِ اجْعَلُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ فِی رِحالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَعْرِفُونَها إِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلی أَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُونَ یَعْنِی کَیْ یَرْجِعُونَ{یَرْجِعُوا} فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا إِلی أَبِیهِمْ قالُوا یا أَبانا مُنِعَ مِنَّا الْکَیْلُ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنا أَخانا نَکْتَلْ وَ إِنَّا لَهُ لَحافِظُونَ* قالَ یَعْقُوبُ هَلْ آمَنُکُمْ عَلَیْهِ إِلَّا کَما أَمِنْتُکُمْ عَلی أَخِیهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَاللهُ خَیْرٌحافِظاً وَ هُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِینَ* وَ لَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَیْهِمْ فِی رِحَالِهِمُ الَّتِی حَمَلُوهَا إِلَی مِصْرَ قالُوا یا أَبانا ما نَبْغِی أَیْ مَا نُرِیدُ هذِهِ بِضاعَتُنا رُدَّتْ إِلَیْنا وَ نَمِیرُ أَهْلَنا وَ نَحْفَظُ أَخانا وَ نَزْدادُ کَیْلَ بَعِیرٍ ذلِکَ کَیْلٌ یَسِیرٌ قالَ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُ مَعَکُمْ حَتَّی تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقاً مِنَ اللهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِی بِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ یُحاطَ بِکُمْ فَلَمَّا آتَوْهُ مَوْثِقَهُمْ قالَ یَعْقُوبُ اللهُ عَلی ما نَقُولُ وَکِیلٌ* فَخَرَجُوا وَ قَالَ لَهُمْ یَعْقُوبُ لاتَدْخُلُوا مِنْ بابٍ واحِدٍ وَ ادْخُلُوا مِنْ أَبْوابٍ مُتَفَرِّقَةٍ وَ ما أُغْنِی عَنْکُمْ مِنَ اللهِ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِنِ الْحُکْمُ إِلَّا للهِ عَلَیْهِ تَوَکَّلْتُ وَ عَلَیْهِ فَلْیَتَوَکَّلِ الْمُتَوَکِّلُونَ* وَ لَمَّا دَخَلُوا مِنْ حَیْثُ أَمَرَهُمْ أَبُوهُمْ ما کانَ یُغْنِی عَنْهُمْ مِنَ اللهِ مِنْ شَیْءٍ إِلَّا حاجَةً فِی نَفْسِ یَعْقُوب قَضاها وَ إِنَّهُ لَذُو عِلْمٍ لِما عَلَّمْناهُ وَ لکِنَّ أَکْثَرَ النَّاسِ لایَعْلَمُونَ.
62.en:
There was a distance of eighteen days between Yusuf (peace be upon him) and his father, and he (Yaqub) was living in the desert. People from all horizons were traveling to Egypt to obtain food. Yaqub (peace be upon him) and his sons were staying in a desert area where there was a medicinal plant called "muql." The brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) took some of this muql and carried it to Egypt to trade it for food. Yusuf (peace be upon him) was personally overseeing the sales. When his brothers entered upon Yusuf (peace be upon him), he recognized them, but they did not recognize him, just as Allah the Almighty has narrated: "And they were unaware of him."

When he had provided them with their provisions and given to them, and had been generous to them in the measure, he said to them, "Who are you?" They replied, "We are the sons of Yaqub ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim (peace be upon him), the Friend of Allah, whom Nimrod cast into the fire, but he did not burn, for Allah made it cool and safe for him." He asked, "What has become of your father?" They said, "He is an old, weak man." He asked, "Do you have a brother other than yourselves?" They said, "We have a brother from our father, not from our mother." He said, "When you return to me, bring him to me." This is the meaning of His words: "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do you not see that I give full measure and that I am the best of hosts? But if you do not bring him to me, there shall be no measure for you with me, nor shall you come near me." They said, "We will attempt to persuade his father about him, and we will certainly do it."

Then Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to his people, "Return this merchandise which they brought to us; place it within their saddlebags so that when they return to their homes and see it, they will return to us." This is the meaning of His words: "And he said to his servants, 'Put their merchandise into their saddlebags so that they may recognize it when they return to their families, perhaps they will return.'" That is, so that they might return.

When they returned to their father, they said, "O our father, the measure is withheld from us, so send our brother with us that we may get our measure, and we will indeed be his guardians." Yaqub said, "Shall I entrust him to you except as I entrusted you with his brother before? But Allah is the best guardian, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful." And when they opened their baggage, they found their merchandise had been returned to them in their saddlebags which they had carried to Egypt. They said, "O our father, what more could we desire?"—meaning, what more do we want? "This is our merchandise returned to us, and we will provide for our family, and we will guard our brother, and we will obtain an extra camel-load; that is a small measure."

Yaqub (peace be upon him) said, "I will never send him with you until you give me a solemn oath by Allah that you will surely bring him back to me, unless you are surrounded." And when they had given him their solemn oath, Yaqub said, "Allah is witness over what we say."

When they were about to depart, Yaqub said to them, "Do not enter from one gate, but enter from different gates; and I cannot avail you against Allah at all. The decision is only for Allah; upon Him I have relied, and upon Him let the reliant rely." And when they entered from where their father had ordered them, it did not avail them against Allah at all, except for a need in the soul of Yaqub which he fulfilled. And indeed, he was possessed of knowledge because of what We had taught him, but most of the people do not know.
62.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 96
62.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 236; Al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 346

62.ar: لَمَّا أَصَابَ آلَ یَعْقُوبَ (علیه السلام) مَا أَصَابَ النَّاسَ مِنْ ضِیقِ الطَّعَامِ جَمَعَ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) بَنِیهِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ یَا بَنِیَّ إِنَّهُ بَلَغَنِی أَنَّهُ یُبَاعُ بِمِصْرَ طَعَامٌ طَیِّبٌ وَ أَنَّ صَاحِبَهُ رَجُلٌ صَالِحٌ لَا یَحْبِسُ النَّاسَ فَاذْهَبُوا إِلَیْهِ وَ اشْتَرُوْا مِنْهُ طَعَاماً فَإِنَّهُ سَیُحْسِنُ إِلَیْکُمْ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ فَتَجَهَّزُوا وَ سَارُوا حَتَّی وَرَدُوا مِصْرَ فَأُدْخِلُوا عَلَی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَ هُمْ لَهُ مُنْکِرُونَ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مَنْ أَنْتُمْ قَالُوا نَحْنُ أَوْلَادُ یَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (علیه السلام) خَلِیلِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَ نَحْنُ مِنْ جَبَلِ کَنْعَانَ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) وَلَّدَکُمْ إِذاً ثَلَاثَةُ أَنْبِیَاءَ (وَ مَا أَنْتُمْ بِحُلَمَاءَ وَ لَا فِیکُمْ وَقَارٌ وَ لَا خُشُوعٌ فَلَعَلَّکُمْ جَوَاسِیسُ لِبَعْضِ الْمُلُوکِ جِئْتُمْ إِلَی بِلَادِی فَقَالُوا أَیُّهَا الْمَلِکُ لَسْنَا بِجَوَاسِیسَ وَ لَا أَصْحَابَ الْحَرْبِ وَ لَوْ تَعْلَمُ بِأَبِینَا إِذاً لَکَرُمْنَا عَلَیْکَ فَإِنَّهُ نَبِیُّ اللَّهِ وَ ابْنُ أَنْبِیَائِهِ (وَ إِنَّهُ لَمَحْزُونٌ قَالَ لَهُمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) فَمِمَّا حُزْنُهُ وَ هُوَ نَبِیُّ اللَّهِ وَ ابْنُ أَنْبِیَائِهِ وَ الْجَنَّةُ مَأْوَاهُ وَ هُوَ یَنْظُرُ إِلَیْکُمْ فِی مِثْلِ عَدَدِکُمْ وَ قُوَّتِکُمْ فَلَعَلَّ حُزْنَهُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ مِنْ قِبَلِ سَفَهِکُمْ وَ جَهْلِکُمْ وَ کَذِبِکُمْ وَ کَیْدِکُمْ وَ مَکْرِکُمْ قَالُوا أَیُّهَا الْمَلِکُ لَسْنَا بِجُهَّالٍ وَ لَا سُفَهَاءَ وَ لَا أَتَاهُ الْحُزْنُ مِنْ قِبَلِنَا وَ لَکِنْ کَانَ لَهُ ابْنٌ کَانَ أَصْغَرَنَا سِنّاً یُقَالُ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) فَخَرَجَ مَعَنَا إِلَی الصَّیْدِ فَأَکَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ فَلَمْ یَزَلْ بَعْدَهُ کَئِیباً حَزِیناً بَاکِیاً فَقَالَ لَهُمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) کُلُّکُمْ مِنْ أَبٍ وَاحِدٍ قَالُوا أَبُونَا وَاحِدٌ وَ أُمَّهَاتُنَا شَتَّی قَالَ فَمَا حَمَلَ أَبَاکُمْ عَلَی أَنْ سَرَّحَکُمْ کُلَّکُمْ أَلَّا حَبَسَ مِنْکُمْ وَاحِداً یَأْنَسُ بِهِ وَ یَسْتَرِیحُ إِلَیْهِ قَالُوا قَدْ فَعَلَ قَدْ حَبَسَ مِنَّا وَاحِداً هُوَ أَصْغَرُنَا سِنّاً قَالَ وَ لِمَ اخْتَارَهُ لِنَفْسِهِ مِنْ بَیْنِکُمْ قَالُوا لِأَنَّهُ أَحَبُّ أَوْلَادِهِ إِلَیْهِ بَعْدَ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ لَهُمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) إِنِّی أَحْبِسُ مِنْکُمْ وَاحِداً یَکُونُ عِنْدِی وَ ارْجِعُوا إِلَی أَبِیکُمْ وَ أَقْرِءُوهُ مِنِّی السَّلَامَ وَ قُولُوا لَهُ یُرْسِلْ إِلَیَّ بِابْنِهِ الَّذِی زَعَمْتُمْ أَنَّهُ حَبَسَهُ عِنْدَهُ لِیُخْبِرَنِی عَنْ حُزْنِهِ مَا الَّذِی أَحْزَنَهُ وَ عَنْ سُرْعَةِ الشَّیْبِ إِلَیْهِ قَبْلَ أَوَانِ مَشِیبِهِ وَ عَنْ بُکَائِهِ وَ ذَهَابِ بَصَرِهِ فَلَمَّا قَالَ هَذَا اقْتَرَعُوا بَیْنَهُمْ فَخَرَجَتِ الْقُرْعَةُ عَلَی شَمْعُونَ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَحُبِسَ فَلَمَّا وَدَّعُوا شَمْعُونَ قَالَ لَهُمْ یَا إِخْوَتَاهْ انْظُرُوا مَا ذَا وَقَعْتُ فِیهِ وَ أَقْرِءُوا وَالِدِی مِنِّی السَّلَامَ فَوَدَّعُوهُ وَ سَارُوا حَتَّی وَرَدُوا الشَّامَ وَ دَخَلُوا عَلَی یَعْقُوبَ (علیه السلام) وَ سَلَّمُوا عَلَیْهِ سَلَاماً ضَعِیفاً فَقَالَ لَهُمْ یَا بَنِیَّ مَا لَکُمْ تُسَلِّمُونَ سَلَاماً ضَعِیفاً وَ مَا لِی لَا أَسْمَعُ فِیکُمْ صَوْتَ خَلِیلِی شَمْعُونَ قَالُوا یَا أَبَانَا إِنَّا جِئْنَاکَ مِنْ عِنْدِ أَعْظَمِ النَّاسِ مُلْکاً لَمْ یَرَ النَّاسُ مِثْلَهُ حُکْماً وَ عِلْماً وَ خُشُوعاً وَ سَکِینَةً وَ وَقَاراً وَ لَئِنْ کَانَ لَکَ شَبِیهٌ فَإِنَّهُ لَشَبِیهُکَ وَ لَکِنَّا أَهْلُ بَیْتٍ خُلِقْنَا لِلْبَلَاءِ اتَّهَمَنَا الْمَلِکُ وَ زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ لَا یُصَدِّقُنَا حَتَّی تُرْسِلَ مَعَنَا بِابْنِ یَامِینَ بِرِسَالَةٍ مِنْکَ یُخْبِرُهُ عَنْ حُزْنِکَ وَ عَنْ سُرْعَةِ الشَّیْبِ إِلَیْکَ قَبْلَ أَوَانِ الْمَشِیبِ وَ عَنْ بُکَائِکَ وَ ذَهَابِ بَصَرِکَ فَظَنَّ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) أَنَّ ذَلِکَ مَکْرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ یَا بَنِیَّ بِئْسَ الْعَادَةُ عَادَتُکُمْ کُلَّمَا خَرَجْتُمْ فِی وَجْهٍ نَقَصَ مِنْکُمْ وَاحِدٌ لَا أُرْسِلُهُ مَعَکُمْ {فَ} لَمَّا فَتَحُوا مَتاعَهُمْ وَجَدُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ رُدَّتْ إِلَیْهِمْ مِنْ غَیْرِ عِلْمٍ مِنْهُمْ أَقْبَلُوا إِلَی أَبِیهِمْ فَرِحِینَ قَالُوا یَا أَبَانَا مَا رَأَی النَّاسُ مِثْلَ هَذَا الْمَلِکِ أَشَدَّ اتِّقَاءً لِلْإِثْمِ مِنْهُ رَدَّ عَلَیْنَا بِضَاعَتَنَا مَخَافَةَ الْإِثْمِ وَ هِیَ بِضاعَتُنا رُدَّتْ إِلَیْنا وَ نَمِیرُ أَهْلَنا وَ نَحْفَظُ أَخانا وَ نَزْدادُ کَیْلَ بَعِیرٍ ذلِکَ کَیْلٌ یَسِیرٌ قَالَ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) قَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ أَنَّ ابْنَ یَامِینَ أَحَبُّکُمْ إِلَیَّ بَعْدَ أَخِیکُمْ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) وَ بِهِ أُنْسِی وَ إِلَیْهِ سُکُونِی مِنْ بَیْنِ جَمَاعَتِکُمْ فَ لَنْ أُرْسِلَهُ مَعَکُمْ حَتَّی تُؤْتُونِ مَوْثِقاً مِنَ اللهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِی بِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ یُحاطَ بِکُمْ فَضَمِنَهُ یَهُودَا فَخَرَجُوا حَتَّی وَرَدُوا مِصْرَ فَدَخَلُوا عَلَی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ لَهُمْ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُمْ رِسَالَتِی قَالُوا نَعَمْ وَ قَدْجِئْنَاکَ بِجَوَابِهَا مَعَ هَذَا الْغُلَامِ فَسَلْهُ عَمَّا بَدَا لَکَ قَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) بِمَا أَرْسَلَکَ أَبُوکَ إِلَیَّ یَا غُلَامُ قَالَ أَرْسَلَنِی إِلَیْکَ یُقْرِئُکَ السَّلَامَ وَ یَقُولُ إِنَّکَ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَیَّ تَسْأَلُنِی عَنْ حُزْنِی وَ عَنْ سُرْعَةِ الشَّیْبِ إِلَیَّ قَبْلَ أَوَانِ الْمَشِیبِ وَ عَنْ بُکَائِی وَ ذَهَابِ بَصَرِی فَإِنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ حُزْناً وَ خَوْفاً أَذْکَرُهُمْ لِلْمَعَادِ وَ إِنَّمَا أَسْرَعَ الشَّیْبُ إِلَیَّ قَبْلَ أَوَانِ الْمَشِیبِ لِذِکْرِ یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَةِ وَ أَبْکَانِی وَ بَیَّضَ عَیْنِیَ الْحُزْنُ عَلَی حَبِیبِی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) وَ قَدْ بَلَغَنِی حُزْنُکَ بِحُزْنِی وَ اهْتِمَامُکَ بِأَمْرِی فَکَانَ اللَّهُ لَکَ جَازِیاً وَ مُثِیباً وَ إِنَّکَ لَنْ تَصِلَنِی بِشَیْءٍ أَنَا أَشَدُّ فَرَحاً بِهِ مِنْ أَنْ تُعَجِّلَ عَلَیَّ وَلَدِی ابْنَ یَامِینَ فَإِنَّهُ أَحَبُّ أَوْلَادِی إِلَیَّ بَعْدَ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) فَأُونِسَ بِهِ وَحْشَتِی وَ أَصِلَ بِهِ وَحْدَتِی تُعَجِّلَ عَلَیَّ بِمَا أَسْتَعِینُ بِهِ عَلَی عِیَالِی فَلَمَّا قَالَ هَذَا خَنَقَتْ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) الْعَبْرَةُ وَ لَمْ یَصْبِرْ حَتَّی قَامَ فَدَخَلَ الْبَیْتَ وَ بَکَی سَاعَةً ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَیْهِمْ وَ أَمَرَ لَهُمْ بِطَعَامٍ وَ قَالَ لِیَجْلِسْ کُلُّ بَنِی أُمٍّ عَلَی مَائِدَةٍ فَجَلَسُوا وَ بَقِیَ ابْنُ یَامِینَ قَائِماً فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) مَا لَکَ لَمْ تَجْلِسْ فَقَالَ لَهُ لَیْسَ لِی فِیهِمْ ابْنُ أُمٍّ فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَ فَمَا کَانَ لَکَ ابْنُ أُمٍّ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ یَامِینَ بَلَی فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) فَمَا فَعَلَ قَالَ زَعَمَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَکَلَهُ قَالَ فَمَا بَلَغَ مِنْ حُزْنِکَ عَلَیْهِ قَالَ وُلِدَ لِی اثْنَا عَشَرَ ابْناً کُلُّهُمُ أَشْتَقُّ لَهُ اسْماً مِنِ اسْمِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَرَاکَ قَدْ عَانَقْتَ النِّسَاءَ وَ شَمَمْتَ الْوَلَدَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ ابْنُ یَامِینَ إِنَّ لِی أَباً صَالِحاً وَ إِنَّهُ قَالَ لِی تَزَوَّجْ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوَجَلَّ یُخْرِجُ مِنْکَ ذُرِّیَّةً یُثْقِلُ الْأَرْضَ بِالتَّسْبِیحِ فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) تَعَالَ فَاجْلِسْ عَلَی مَائِدَتِی فَقَالَ إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) لَقَدْ فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) وَ أَخَاهُ حَتَّی إِنَّ الْمَلِکَ قَدْ أَجْلَسَهُ مَعَهُ عَلَی مَائِدَتِهِ فَأَمَرَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَنْ یُجْعَلَ صُوَاعُ الْمَلِکِ فِی رَحْلِ ابْنِ یَامِینَ.
62.en: When the family of Ya‘qub (peace be upon him) was afflicted by the same food shortage that had affected the rest of the people, Ya‘qub (peace be upon him) gathered his sons and said to them, "O my sons, it has reached me that good food is being sold in Egypt and that its master is a righteous man who does not imprison people. Go to him and buy food from him, for he will surely be kind to you, if Allah wills." They prepared their provisions and traveled until they arrived in Egypt and were brought before Yusuf (peace be upon him). He recognized them, while they were unaware of who he was. He asked them, "Who are you?" They replied, "We are the sons of Ya‘qub ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim (peace be upon him), the Khalil of the Most Merciful, and we are from the mountains of Canaan." Yusuf (peace be upon him) said, "Then three prophets have sired you, yet you lack forbearance, dignity, and humility. Perhaps you are spies for some king who have come to my lands?" They said, "O King, we are not spies, nor are we people of war. If you knew our father, you would honor us, for he is a Prophet of Allah and the son of His prophets, and he is a man of great sorrow." Yusuf (peace be upon him) asked them, "What is the cause of his sorrow, when he is a Prophet of Allah and the son of His prophets, and Paradise is his abode? He looks upon you, who are many in number and strength; perhaps his sorrow is due to your foolishness, ignorance, lies, deceit, and craftiness?" They said, "O King, we are not ignorant or foolish, and his sorrow did not come from us. Rather, he had a son who was the youngest of us, called Yusuf (peace be upon him). He went out with us to hunt, and the wolf ate him. Since then, he has remained depressed, sorrowful, and weeping." Yusuf (peace be upon him) asked them, "Are you all from one father?" They replied, "Our father is one, but our mothers are different." He asked, "What compelled your father to send all of you and not keep one of you back to be his companion and source of comfort?" They said, "He has done so; he kept one of us back, the youngest of us." He asked, "Why did he choose him for himself from among you?" They said, "Because he is the most beloved of his children to him after Yusuf (peace be upon him)." Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to them, "I will detain one of you to stay with me. Return to your father and convey my greetings to him, and tell him to send me his son whom you claim he kept with him, so that he may inform me about his sorrow—what has saddened him, the cause of his hair turning gray before its time, his weeping, and the loss of his sight." When he said this, they cast lots among themselves, and the lot fell upon Sham‘un. He ordered him to be detained. When they bade farewell to Sham‘un, he said to them, "O my brothers, look at what has befallen me, and convey my greetings to my father." They bade him farewell and traveled until they reached the Levant and entered upon Ya‘qub (peace be upon him), greeting him with weak voices. He said to them, "O my sons, why do you greet me with weak voices, and why do I not hear the voice of my beloved Sham‘un among you?" They said, "O our father, we have come to you from the greatest of kings in terms of dominion; people have never seen his like in judgment, knowledge, humility, tranquility, and dignity. If you had an equal, it would be him. But we are a household created for trials. The King accused us and claimed he would not believe us until you send Binyamin with us, along with a message from you informing him of your sorrow, the cause of your hair turning gray before its time, your weeping, and the loss of your sight." Ya‘qub (peace be upon him) suspected that this was a ruse of theirs and said to them, "O my sons, what a wretched habit you have! Every time you go out on a journey, one of you is lost. I will not send him with you." When they opened their luggage, they found their goods had been returned to them without their knowledge. They went to their father, rejoicing, and said, "O our father, people have never seen a king like this, more fearful of sin than he; he returned our goods to us out of fear of sin. Here is our merchandise returned to us, and we will provide for our family, protect our brother, and gain an extra camel-load; that is an easy load." Ya‘qub (peace be upon him) said, "You know that Binyamin is the most beloved of you to me after your brother Yusuf (peace be upon him), and he is my comfort and my solace among you all. I will never send him with you until you give me a solemn oath by Allah that you will surely bring him back to me, unless you are surrounded." Yahuda guaranteed it, and they went out until they arrived in Egypt and entered upon Yusuf (peace be upon him). He said to them, "Have you delivered my message?" They said, "Yes, and we have brought you the answer with this boy; ask him about whatever occurs to you." Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to the boy, "With what message did your father send you to me?" He said, "He sent me to you to convey his greetings and to say: 'You wrote to me asking about my sorrow, the cause of my hair turning gray before its time, my weeping, and the loss of my sight. Indeed, the most sorrowful and fearful of people are those who most remember the Hereafter. My hair turned gray before its time only because of the remembrance of the Day of Resurrection, and the sorrow for my beloved Yusuf (peace be upon him) has made me weep and whitened my eyes. It has reached me that you are saddened by my sorrow and concerned for my affairs; may Allah reward and recompense you. The best thing you can do to please me is to hasten my son Binyamin back to me, for he is the most beloved of my children to me after Yusuf (peace be upon him); I find comfort in him and solace in my loneliness. Hasten to me with that which will help me support my family.'" When he said this, Yusuf (peace be upon him) was choked with tears and could not restrain himself; he stood up, entered the house, and wept for a while. Then he went out to them and ordered food for them, saying, "Let every brother from the same mother sit at one table." They sat, but Binyamin remained standing. Yusuf (peace be upon him) asked him, "Why have you not sat?" He replied, "I have no brother from the same mother among them." Yusuf (peace be upon him) asked, "Did you not have a brother from your mother?" Binyamin replied, "Yes." Yusuf (peace be upon him) asked, "What happened to him?" He said, "These people claim that a wolf ate him." He asked, "How deep is your sorrow for him?" He said, "I have had twelve sons, and I have derived each of their names from his name." Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to him, "I see that you have embraced women and smelled children after him." Binyamin replied, "I have a righteous father who told me, 'Marry, perhaps Allah the Almighty will bring forth from you a progeny that will fill the earth with His praise.'" Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to him, "Come and sit at my table." The brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) said, "Allah has favored Yusuf (peace be upon him) and his brother, to the extent that the King has seated him with him at his table." Yusuf (peace be upon him) then ordered that the King's drinking cup be placed in the luggage of Binyamin.
62.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 100

62.ar: فَأَمَرَ یُوسُفُ أَنْ یَبْنِیَ کَنَادِیجَ مِنْ صَخْرٍ وَ طَیَّنَهَا بِالْکِلْسِ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِزُرُوعِ مِصْرَ فَحُصِدَتْ وَ دَفَعَ إِلَی کُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ حِصَّتَهُ وَ تَرَکَ الْبَاقِیَ فِی سُنْبُلِهِ لَمْ یَدُسْهُ، فَوَضَعَهَا فِی الْکَنَادِیجِ فَفَعَلَ ذَلِکَ سَبْعَ سِنِینَ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سِنِی الْجَدْبِ فَکَانَ یَخْرُجُ السُّنْبُلُ فَیَبِیعُ بِمَا شَاءَ، وَ کَانَ بَیْنَهُ وَ بَیْنَ أَبِیهِ ثَمَانِیَةَ عَشَرَ یَوْماً وَ کَانُوا فِی بَادِیَةٍ وَ کَانَ النَّاسُ مِنَ الْآفَاقِ یَخْرُجُونَ إِلَی مِصْرَ لِیَمْتَارُوا طَعَاماً وَ کَانَ یَعْقُوبُ وَ وُلْدُهُ نُزُولًا فِی بَادِیَةٍ فِیهِ مُقْلٌ فَأَخَذَ إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الْمُقْلِ وَ حَمَلُوهُ إِلَی مِصْرَ لِیَمْتَارُوا بِهِ وَ کَانَ یُوسُفُ یَتَوَلَّی الْبَیْعَ بِنَفْسِهِ فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا إِخْوَتُهُ عَلَی یُوسُفَ عَرَفَهُمْ وَ لَمْ یَعْرِفُوهُ کَمَا حَکَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ عَلَا وَ هُمْ لَهُ مُنْکِرُونَ وَ لَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمْ بِجَهازِهِمْ وَ أَعْطَاهُمْ وَ أَحْسَنَ إِلَیْهِمْ فِی الْکَیْلِ قَالَ لَهُمْ مَنْ أَنْتُمْ قَالُوا نَحْنُ بَنُو یَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِیمَ خَلِیلِ اللَّهِ الَّذِی أَلْقَاهُ نُمْرُودُ فِی النَّارِ فَلَمْ یَحْتَرِقْ وَ جَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ بَرْداً وَ سَلاماً، قَالَ فَمَا فَعَلَ أَبُوکُمْ قَالُوا شَیْخٌ ضَعِیفٌ، قَالَ فَلَکُمْ أَخٌ غَیْرُکُمْ قَالُوا لَنَا أَخٌ مِنْ أَبِینَا لَا مِنْ أُمِّنَا، قَالَ فَإِذَا رَجَعْتُمْ إِلَیَّ فَأْتُونِی بِهِ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ ائْتُونِی بِأَخٍ لَکُمْ مِنْ أَبِیکُمْ. أَ لا تَرَوْنَ أَنِّی أُوفِی الْکَیْلَ وَ أَنَا خَیْرُ الْمُنْزِلِینَ. فَإِنْ لَمْ تَأْتُونِی بِهِ فَلا کَیْلَ لَکُمْ عِنْدِی وَ لا تَقْرَبُونِ. قالُوا سَنُراوِدُ عَنْهُ أَباهُ وَ إِنَّا لَفاعِلُونَ ثُمَّ قَالَ یُوسُفُ لِقَوْمِهِ رُدُّوا هَذِهِ الْبِضَاعَةَ الَّتِی حَمَلُوهَا إِلَیْنَا وَ اجْعَلُوهَا فِیمَا بَیْنَ رِحَالِهِمْ حَتَّی إِذَا رَجَعُوا إِلَی مَنَازِلِهِمْ وَ رَأَوْهَا رَجَعُوا إِلَیْنَا وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ وَ قالَ لِفِتْیانِهِ اجْعَلُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ فِی رِحالِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَعْرِفُونَها إِذَا انْقَلَبُوا إِلی أَهْلِهِمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَرْجِعُونَ یَعْنِی کَیْ یَرْجِعُوا.
62.en: Yusuf ordered that silos be built out of stone and lined with lime. He then ordered the crops of Egypt to be harvested; he gave every person their share and left the remainder in its stalks without threshing it, storing it in the silos. He did this for seven years. When the years of drought arrived, he would take out the stalks and sell them for whatever price he wished. The distance between him and his father was eighteen days, and they were in the desert. People from all horizons would travel to Egypt to obtain food. Ya’qub and his sons were staying in a desert where there were *muql* (doum palm) trees. Yusuf’s brothers took some of that *muql* and carried it to Egypt to trade for food. Yusuf would handle the sales himself. When his brothers entered upon Yusuf, he recognized them, but they did not recognize him, as Allah the Almighty and Exalted narrated: "And they were unaware of him." When he had provided them with their provisions, given them their share, and treated them kindly in the measuring, he said to them, "Who are you?" They replied, "We are the sons of Ya’qub ibn Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, the Friend of Allah, whom Nimrod cast into the fire, yet he did not burn, for Allah made it cool and peaceful for him." He asked, "And what has become of your father?" They said, "He is a weak, old man." He asked, "Do you have a brother other than yourselves?" They said, "We have a brother from our father, but not from our mother." He said, "When you return to me, bring him to me." This is the meaning of His saying: "Bring me a brother of yours from your father. Do you not see that I give full measure and that I am the best of hosts? But if you do not bring him to me, there shall be no measure for you with me, nor shall you come near me." They said, "We will attempt to persuade his father about him, and we will surely do it." Then Yusuf said to his people, "Return this merchandise which they brought to us and place it within their baggage, so that when they return to their homes and see it, they will return to us." This is the meaning of His saying: "And he said to his young men, 'Put their merchandise into their saddlebags so that they might recognize it when they return to their people, that perhaps they might return,'" meaning, so that they would return.
62.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 104
62.refs: Qumi, Vol. 1, p. 346; al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn (contains: "And when... and Allah made it cool for him... that they might return" [omitted sections]).

62.ar: عَلِیُّ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِیلَ الْمِیثَمِیُّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا رِبْعِیُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ لِی قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ البصری: قُلْتُ لِأَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) الْمُنْکِرُ لِهَذَا الْأَمْرِ مِنْ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ وَ غَیْرِهِمْ سَوَاءٌ فَقَالَ لِی لَا تَقُلِ الْمُنْکِرُ وَ لَکِنْ قُلِ الْجَاحِدُ مِنْ بَنِی هَاشِمٍ وَ غَیْرِهِمْ قَالَ أَبُوالْحَسَنِ فَتَفَکَّرْتُ فِیهِ فَذَکَرْتُ قَوْلَ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِی إِخْوَةِ یُوسُفَ فَعَرَفَهُمْ وَ هُمْ لَهُ مُنْکِرُونَ.
62.en: Ali ibn Isma'il al-Maythami said: Rib'i ibn Abd Allah narrated to us, saying: Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abd Allah al-Basri said to me: I said to Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him), "Are those who deny this matter [Imamate] from the Banu Hashim and others equal?" He said to me, "Do not say 'denier' (munkir), but rather say 'rejecter' (jahid) from the Banu Hashim and others." Al-Maythami said: I reflected upon this and remembered the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, regarding the brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him): "And Yusuf recognized them, while they were to him rejecters (munkirun)."
62.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 106

62.ar: إنَّا وَ اللَّهِ لَا نَعُدُّ الرَّجُلَ مِنْ شِیعَتِنَا فَقِیهاً حَتَّی یُلْحَنَ لَهُ فَیَعْرِفَ اللَّحْنَ إِنَّ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) قَالَ عَلَی مِنْبَرِ الْکُوفَةِ وَ إِنَّ مِنْ وَرَائِکُمْ فِتَناً مُظْلِمَةً عَمْیَاءَ مُنْکَسِفَةً لَا یَنْجُو مِنْهَا إِلَّا النُّوَمَةُ قِیلَ یَا أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) وَ مَا النُّوَمَةُ قَالَ الَّذِی یَعْرِفُ النَّاسَ وَ لَا یَعْرِفُونَهُ وَ اعْلَمُوا أَنَّ الْأَرْضَ لَاتَخْلُو مِنْ حُجَّةٍ لِلَّهِ وَ لَکِنَّ اللَّهَ سَیُعْمِی خَلْقَهُ مِنْهَا بِظُلْمِهِمْ وَ جَوْرِهِمْ وَ إِسْرَافِهِمْ عَلَی أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَ لَوْ خَلَتِ الْأَرْضُ سَاعَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ حُجَّةٍ لِلَّهِ لَسَاخَتْ بِأَهْلِهَا وَ لَکِنَّ الْحُجَّةَ یَعْرِفُ النَّاسَ وَ لَا یَعْرِفُونَهُ کَمَا کَانَ یُوسُفُ یَعْرِفُ النَّاسَ وَ هُمْ لَهُ مُنْکِرُونَ.
62.fa: به خدا سوگند! کسی از شیعیان خود را فقیه نمی‌شماریم تا اینکه به رمز سخنی به او گفته می‌شود و او آن رمز را دریابد، همانا امیرالمؤمنین (علیه السلام) بر منبر کوفه فرمود: «به‌راستی که فتنه‌هایی ظلمانی و کدر و تاریک پشت سر دارید که جز نومه (کسی که عنوانی در مردم ندارد و به کلّی قدرش مجهول و ناشناخته است) کسی از آن نجات نمی‌یابد، به آن حضرت عرض شد: «ای امیرمؤمنان (علیه السلام) نومه چیست»؟ فرمود: «آن کسی است که مردم را می‌شناسد ولی مردم او را نمی‌شناسند. بدانید که زمین از حجّت خدای عزّوجلّ خالی نمی‌ماند ولی خدای عزیز به‌زودی دیده‌ی خلقش را به خاطر ظلم و ستم و زیاده روی آنان نسبت به خودشان از او نابینا می‌سازد و اگر زمین یک ساعت از حجّت خدا خالی بماند اهل خود را فرومی‌برد، ولیکن آن حجّت مردم را می‌شناسد و آنان او را نمی‌شناسند، چنان‌که یوسف (علیه السلام) مردم را [برادرانش را] می‌شناخت ولی آن‌ها او را نشناختند».
62.en: By Allah, we do not consider a man from our Shia to be a jurist (faqih) until he is spoken to in riddles and he understands the riddle. Verily, the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said from the pulpit of Kufa: "Indeed, behind you are dark, blind, and eclipsed tribulations from which none shall be saved except the 'nawmah'." It was said, "O Commander of the Faithful, what is the 'nawmah'?" He replied, "The one who knows the people, but the people do not know him. And know that the earth is never devoid of a proof (Hujjah) for Allah, but Allah will soon blind His creation to him because of their oppression, tyranny, and excess against their own souls. If the earth were to be devoid of a proof for Allah for even a single hour, it would swallow its inhabitants. However, the proof knows the people while they do not know him, just as Yusuf (peace be upon him) knew the people [his brothers], but they were oblivious to him."
62.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 106

64.ar: لَمَّا فَقَدَ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) اشْتَدَّ حُزْنُهُ عَلَیْهِ وَ بُکَاؤُهُ حَتَّی ابْیَضَّتْ عَیْناهُ مِنَ الْحُزْنِ وَ احْتَاجَ حَاجَةً شَدِیدَةً وَ تَغَیَّرَتْ حَالُهُ قَالَ وَ کَانَ یَمْتَارُ الْقَمْحَ مِنْ مِصْرَ لِعِیَالِهِ فِی السَّنَةِ مَرَّتَیْنِ لِلشِّتَاءِ وَ الصَّیْفِ وَ إِنَّهُ بَعَثَ عِدَّةً مِنْ وُلْدِهِ بِبِضَاعَةٍ یَسِیرَةٍ إِلَی مِصْرَ مَعَ رِفْقَةٍ خَرَجَتْ فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) وَ ذَلِکَ بَعْدَ مَا وَلَّاهُ الْعَزِیزُ مِصْرَ فَعَرَفَهُمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) وَ لَمْ یَعْرِفْهُ إِخْوَتُهُ لِهَیْبَةِ الْمَلِکِ وَ عِزِّهِ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ هَلُمُّوا بِضَاعَتَکُمْ قَبْلَ الرِّفَاقِ وَ قَالَ لِفِتْیَانِهِ عَجِّلُوا لِهَؤُلَاءِ الْکَیْلَ وَ أَوْفُوهُمْ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتُمْ فَاجْعَلُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ هَذِهِ فِی رِحَالِهِمْ وَ لَا تُعْلِمُوهُمْ بِذَلِکَ فَفَعَلُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) قَدْ بَلَغَنِی أَنَّهُ کَانَ لَکُمْ أَخَوَانِ لِأَبِیکُمْ فَمَا فَعَلَا قَالُوا أَمَّا الْکَبِیرُ مِنْهُمَا فَإِنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَکَلَهُ وَ أَمَّا الصَّغِیرُ فَخَلَّفْنَاهُ عِنْدَ أَبِیهِ وَ هُوَ بِهِ ضَنِینٌ وَ عَلَیْهِ شَفِیقٌ قَالَ فَإِنِّی أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَأْتُونِی بِهِ مَعَکُمْ إِذَا جِئْتُمْ لِتَمْتَارُوا فَإِنْ لَمْ تَأْتُونِی بِهِ فَلا کَیْلَ لَکُمْ عِنْدِی وَ لا تَقْرَبُونِ قالُوا سَنُراوِدُ عَنْهُ أَباهُ وَ إِنَّا لَفاعِلُونَ* فَلَمَّا رَجَعُوا إِلی أَبِیهِمْ ... فَتَحُوا مَتاعَهُمْ فَوَجَدُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ فِیهِ قالُوا یا أَبانا ما نَبْغِی هذِهِ بِضاعَتُنا قَدْ رُدَّتْ إِلَیْنا وَ کِیلَ لَنَا کَیْلٌ قَدْ زَادَ حِمْلَ بَعِیرٍ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنا أَخانا نَکْتَلْ وَ إِنَّا لَهُ لَحافِظُونَ قالَ هَلْ آمَنُکُمْ عَلَیْهِ إِلَّا کَما أَمِنْتُکُمْ عَلی أَخِیهِ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَلَمَّا احْتَاجُوا إِلَی الْمِیرَةِ بَعْدَ سِتَّةِ أَشْهُرٍ بَعَثَهُمْ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام) وَ بَعَثَ مَعَهُمْ بِضَاعَةً یَسِیرَةً وَ بَعَثَ مَعَهُمُ ابْنَ یَامِیلَ{یَامِینَ} وَ أَخَذَ عَلَیْهِمْ بِذَلِکَ مَوْثِقاً مِنَ اللَّهِ لَتَأْتُنَّنِی بِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ یُحاطَ بِکُمْ أَجْمَعِینَ فَانْطَلَقُوا مَعَ الرِّفَاقِ حَتَّی دَخَلُوا عَلَی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ لَهُمْ مَعَکُمُ ابْنُ یَامِیلَ {یَامِینَ} قَالُوا نَعَمْ هُوَ فِی الرَّحْلِ قَالَ لَهُمْ فَأْتُوْنِی بِهِ فَأَتَوْهُ بِهِ وَ هُوَ فِی دَارِ الْمَلِکِ فَقَالَ أَدْخِلُوهُ وَحْدَهُ فَأَدْخَلُوهُ عَلَیْهِ فَضَمَّهُ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) إِلَیْهِ وَ بَکَی وَ قَالَ لَهُ أَنَا أَخُوکَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) فَلَا تَبْتَئِسْ بِمَا تَرَانِی أَعْمَلُ وَ اکْتُمْ مَا أَخْبَرْتُکَ بِهِ وَ لَا تَحْزَنْ وَ لَا تَخَفْ ثُمَّ أَخْرَجَهُ إِلَیْهِمْ وَ أَمَرَ فِتْیَتَهُ أَنْ یَأْخُذُوا بِضَاعَتَهُمْ وَ یُعَجِّلُوا لَهُمُ الْکَیْلَ فَإِذَا فَرَغُوا جَعَلُوا الْمِکْیَالَ فِی رَحْلِ ابْنِ یَامِیلَ {یَامِینَ} فَفَعَلُوا بِهِ ذَلِکَ وَ ارْتَحَلَ الْقَوْمُ مَعَ الرِّفْقَةِ فَمَضَوْا فَلَحِقَهُمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) وَ فِتْیَتُهُ فَنَادَوْا فِیهِمْ أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ قالُوا وَ أَقْبَلُوا عَلَیْهِمْ ما ذا تَفْقِدُونَ* قالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُواعَ الْمَلِکِ وَ لِمَنْ جاءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِیرٍ وَ أَنَا بِهِ زَعِیمٌ* قالُوا تَاللهِ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمْ ما جِئْنا لِنُفْسِدَ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ ما کُنَّا سارِقِینَ* قالُوا فَما جَزاؤُهُ إِنْ کُنْتُمْ کاذِبِینَ* قالُوا جَزاؤُهُ مَنْ وُجِدَ فِی رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزاؤُهُ ... * قَالَ فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِیَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعاءِ أَخِیهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَها مِنْ وِعاءِ أَخِیهِ ... قالُوا إِنْ یَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ ... فَقَالَ لَهُمْ یُوسُفُ ارْتَحِلُوا عَنْ بِلَادِنَا قالُوا یا أَیُّهَا الْعَزِیزُ إِنَّ لَهُ أَباً شَیْخاً کَبِیراً وَ قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَیْنَا مَوْثِقاً مِنَ اللهِ لِنَرُدَّ بِهِ إِلَیْهِ فَخُذْ أَحَدَنا مَکانَهُ إِنَّا نَراکَ مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِینَ* إِنْ فَعَلْتَ قالَ مَعاذَ اللهِ أَنْ نَأْخُذَ إِلَّا مَنْ وَجَدْنا مَتاعَنا عِنْدَهُ ... فَقالَ کَبِیرُهُمْ إِنِّی لَسْتُ أَبْرَحُ الْأَرْضَ حَتَّی یَأْذَنَ لِی أَبِی أَوْ یَحْکُمَ اللَّهُ لِی وَ مَضَی إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) حَتَّی دَخَلُوا عَلَی یَعْقُوبَ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ لَهُمْ فَأَیْنَ ابْنُ یَامِیلَ{یَامِینَ} قَالُوا ابْنُ یَامِیلَ {یَامِینَ} سَرَقَ مِکْیَالَ الْمَلِکِ فَأَخَذَ الْمَلِکُ سَرِقَتَهُ فَحَبَسَ عِنْدَهُ فَاسْأَلْ أَهْلَ الْقَرْیَةِ وَ الْعِیْرَ حَتَّی یُخْبِرُوکَ بِذَلِکَ فَاسْتَرْجَعَ وَ اسْتَعْبَرَ وَ اشْتَدَّ حُزْنُهُ حَتَّی تَقَوَّسَ ظَهْرُهُ.
64.en: When Ya‘qub (peace be upon him) lost Yusuf (peace be upon him), his grief and weeping for him intensified until his eyes turned white from sorrow. He fell into severe need, and his condition changed. It is said that he would travel to Egypt to obtain wheat for his family twice a year, once in the winter and once in the summer. He sent a number of his sons to Egypt with a small amount of capital along with a departing caravan. When they entered upon Yusuf (peace be upon him)—this being after the Aziz had appointed him over Egypt—Yusuf (peace be upon him) recognized them, but his brothers did not recognize him due to the majesty and dignity of the king. He said to them, "Bring your capital before the others," and he said to his servants, "Hasten the measuring for these people and give them full measure. When you have finished, place their capital in their saddlebags without them knowing." They did so. Then Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to them, "It has reached me that you had two brothers from your father; what became of them?" They replied, "As for the elder of the two, the wolf ate him, and as for the younger, we left him with his father, who is attached to him and deeply affectionate toward him." He said, "I would like you to bring him to me with you when you come to obtain provisions. If you do not bring him to me, you shall have no measure from me, nor shall you approach me." They said, "We will attempt to persuade his father about him, and we will indeed do it." When they returned to their father... they opened their baggage and found their capital within it. They said, "O our father, what more could we desire? This is our capital returned to us, and we have been given a measure that exceeds a camel’s load. So send our brother with us so we may obtain a measure, and we will indeed be his guardians." He said, "Shall I entrust him to you except as I entrusted you with his brother before?" When they were in need of provisions six months later, Ya‘qub (peace be upon him) sent them with a small amount of capital and sent with them Ibn Yamin (Benjamin). He took a solemn oath from them by Allah that they would bring him back to him, unless they were completely surrounded. They set out with the caravan until they entered upon Yusuf (peace be upon him). He said to them, "Is Ibn Yamin with you?" They said, "Yes, he is in the caravan." He said, "Bring him to me." They brought him to him while he was in the king’s palace. He said, "Bring him in alone." They brought him in to him, and Yusuf (peace be upon him) embraced him, wept, and said to him, "I am your brother Yusuf (peace be upon him). Do not be distressed by what you see me doing, and conceal what I have told you. Do not grieve, and do not fear." Then he brought him out to them and ordered his servants to take their capital and hasten their measure, and when they finished, to place the measuring cup in the saddlebag of Ibn Yamin. They did so. The group departed with the caravan, and as they went, Yusuf (peace be upon him) and his servants caught up with them and called out to them, "O caravan, you are indeed thieves!" They turned to them and said, "What is it that you have lost?" They said, "We have lost the king’s measuring cup, and whoever brings it shall have a camel’s load, and I am a guarantor for it." They said, "By Allah, you know we did not come to cause corruption in the land, and we were not thieves." They said, "What is its penalty if you are liars?" They said, "Its penalty is that whoever is found in his saddlebag, he is the penalty..." He began with their bags before his brother’s bag, then he extracted it from his brother’s bag... They said, "If he has stolen, a brother of his had stolen before..." Yusuf (peace be upon him) said to them, "Depart from our lands." They said, "O Aziz, he has a very old father, and he has taken a solemn oath from us by Allah to return him to him. So take one of us in his place; we see that you are of the doers of good." He said, "I seek refuge in Allah from taking anyone except him with whom we found our property..." The eldest of them said, "I will not leave this land until my father permits me or Allah decides for me." The brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) went on until they entered upon Ya‘qub (peace be upon him). He said to them, "Where is Ibn Yamin?" They said, "Ibn Yamin stole the king’s measuring cup, so the king took his stolen item and imprisoned him. Ask the people of the town and the caravan, and they will inform you of that." He recited the Istirja‘ (Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji‘un), wept, and his grief intensified until his back became bent.
64.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 106
64.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 12; Al-‘Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 181; Al-Burhan

65.ar: عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَاالْحَسَنِ (علیه السلام) لِمَ سُمِّیَ أَمِیرَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) قَالَ لِأَنَّهُ یَمِیرُهُمْ الْعِلْمَ أَمَا سَمِعْتَ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَ نَمِیرُ أَهْلَنا.
65.fa: احمدبن‌عمر گوید: از امام کاظم (علیه السلام) پرسیدم: «فدایتان شوم! چرا امیرمؤمنان (علیه السلام)، امیرمؤمنان نامیده شد»؟ فرمود: «چون آذوقه‌ای که امام (علیه السلام) به آنان می‌دهد، دانش است؛ مگر این سخن خداوند نَمِیرُ أَهْلَنَا را نشنیده‌ای»؟!
65.en: Ahmad ibn Umar said: I asked Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), "Why was he named Amir al-Mu'minin (Commander of the Faithful)?" He replied, "Because he provides them with knowledge as sustenance (yamiru-hum). Have you not heard in the Book of Allah: 'And we will provide for our family' (wa namiru ahlana)?"
65.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 110
65.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 412; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 37, p. 293; al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 184; 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 1, p. 161; Ma'ani al-Akhbar, p. 63; al-Burhan

66.ar: سُئِلَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ (رحمة الله علیه) عَنِ الْمَوْثِقِ الَّذِی أَخَذَهُ یَعْقُوبُ عَلَی أَوْلَادِهِ؟ فَقَالَ: قَالَ لَهُمْ: مَعْشَرَ أَوْلَادِی، إِنْ جِئْتُمُونِی بِوَلَدِی وَ إِلَّا فَأَنْتُمْ بُرَآءُ مِنَ النَّبِیِّ الْأُمِّیِّ الَّذِی یَکُونُ فِی آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ، لَهُ أُمَّةٌ یَهْدُونَ بِالْحَقِّ وَ بِهِ یَعْدِلُونَ، أَهْلُ کَلِمَةٍ عَظِیمَةٍ، أَعْظَمُ مِنَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، عَلِیٌّ وَلِیُّ اللَّهِ، صَاحِبُ النَّاقَةِ وَ الْقَضِیبِ الَّذِی سَمَّاهُ اللَّهُ حَبِیباً، ذُوالْوَجْهِ الْأَقْمَرِ، وَ الْجَبِینِ الْأَزْهَرِ، وَ الْحَوْضِ وَ الْکَوْثَرِ، وَ الْمَقَامِ الْمَشْهُودِ، لَهُ ابْنُ عَمٍّ یُسَمَّی حَیْدَرَةً، زَوْجُ ابْنَتِهِ، وَ خَلِیفَتُهُ عَلَی قَوْمِهِ، عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام)، تَأْتُونَهُ وَ هُوَ مُعْرِضٌ عَنْکُمْ بِوَجْهِهِ یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَةِ إِنْ خُنْتُمُونِی فِی وَلَدِی. قَالُوا: نَعَمْ. قَالَ یَعْقُوبُ (علیه السلام): فَاللهُ خَیْرٌ حَافِظاً وَ هُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِینَ. قَالُوا: نَعَمْ؛ فَاللهُ خَیْرٌ حافِظاً وَ هُوَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِینَ.
66.en: Ibn Abbas (may Allah have mercy on him) was asked about the solemn pledge that Jacob (peace be upon him) took from his sons. He replied: He said to them, "O my sons, if you do not bring my son back to me, then you are disassociated from the Unlettered Prophet who will appear in the end times. He will have a nation that guides by the truth and judges by it. He is the possessor of a great word, greater than the heavens and the earth: 'There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, Ali is the Wali (friend/representative) of Allah.' He is the possessor of the she-camel and the staff (Qadib), whom Allah has named His Beloved. He is the one with the moon-like face, the radiant forehead, the Basin (Hawd), the Abundance (Kawthar), and the Witnessed Station. He has a cousin named Haydarah, the husband of his daughter and his successor over his people, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him). If you betray me regarding my son, you will come to him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will turn his face away from you." They said, "Yes." Jacob (peace be upon him) said, "So Allah is the best guardian, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful." They said, "Yes; so Allah is the best guardian, and He is the Most Merciful of the merciful."
66.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 112

67.ar: إِنَّ الْعَیْنَ حَقٌّ وَ الْعَیْنُ تَسْتَنْزِلُ الْحَالِقَ.
67.fa: چشم زخم درست است تا آنجا که قلّه‌ی کوه را فرو آورد.
67.en: The evil eye is real, and the evil eye can bring down the mountain peak.
67.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 112

67.ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام): فِی قَولِ اللهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ عَلَی اللهِ فَلْیَتَوَکَّلِ الْمُتَوَکِّلُونَ، قَالَ الزَّارِعُونَ.
67.fa: وَ علَی الله فَلْیَتَوَکَّلِ المُؤْمِنُونَ؛ مقصود، کشاورزان هستند.
67.en: Regarding the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, "And upon Allah let the reliant rely," he said: "It refers to the farmers."
67.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 112

69.ar: فَخَرَجُوا وَ خَرَجَ مَعَهُمْ بِنْیَامِینُ وَ کَانَ لَا یُؤَاکِلُهُمْ وَ لَا یُجَالِسُهُمْ وَ لَا یُکَلِّمُهُمْ فَلَمَّا وَافَوْا مِصْرَ دَخَلُوا عَلَی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) وَ سَلَّمُوا فَنَظَرَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) إِلَی أَخِیهِ فَعَرَفَهُ فَجَلَسَ مِنْهُمْ بِالْبَعِیدِ فَقَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَنْتَ أَخُوهُمْ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَلِمَ لَا تَجْلِسُ مَعَهُمْ قَالَ لِأَنَّهُمْ أَخْرَجُوا أَخِی مِنْ أَبِی وَ أُمِّی ثُمَّ رَجَعُوا وَ لَمْ یَرُدُّوهُ وَ زَعَمُوا أَنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَکَلَهُ فَآلَیْتُ عَلَی نَفْسِی أَنْ لَا أَجْتَمِعَ مَعَهُمْ عَلَی أَمْرٍ مَا دُمْتُ حَیّاً قَالَ فَهَلْ تَزَوَّجْتَ قَالَ بَلَی قَالَ فَوُلِدَ لَکَ وَلَدٌ قَالَ بَلَی قَالَ کَمْ وُلِدَ لَکَ قَالَ ثَلَاثَةُ بَنِینَ قَالَ فَمَا سَمَّیْتَهُمْ قَالَ سَمَّیْتُ وَاحِداً مِنْهُمْ الذِّئْبَ وَ وَاحِداً الْقَمِیصَ وَ وَاحِداً الدَّمَ قَالَ وَ کَیْفَ اخْتَرْتَ هَذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءَ قَالَ لِئَلَّا أَنْسَی أَخِی کُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُ وَاحِداً مِنْ وُلْدِی ذَکَرْتُ أَخِی قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) لَهُمْ اخْرُجُوا وَ حَبَسَ بِنْیَامِینَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجُوا مِنْ عِنْدِهِ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) لِأَخِیهِ أَنَا أَخُوکَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) فَلا تَبْتَئِسْ بِما کانُوا یَعْمَلُونَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ أَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَکُونَ عِنْدِی فَقَالَ لَا یَدَعُونِّی إِخْوَتِی فَإِنَّ أَبِی قَدْ أَخَذَ عَلَیْهِمْ عَهْدَ اللَّهِ وَ مِیثَاقَهُ أَنْ یَرُدُّونِی إِلَیْهِ قَالَ فَأَنَا أَحْتَالُ بِحِیلَةٍ فَلَا تُنْکِرْإِذَا رَأَیْتَ شَیْئاً وَ لَا تُخْبِرْهُمْ فَقَالَ لَا.
69.fa: به هر دلیلی آن‌ها به همراه بنیامین از دیار خود خارج شدند، امّا او با آن‌ها هم کلام نمی‌شد و با ایشان نشست و برخاست نمی‌کرد، وقتی آن‌ها بر یوسف (علیه السلام) وارد شدند و به او سلام کردند، یوسف (علیه السلام) به برادر مادری خود نظر کرد و او را شناخت، و مشاهده کرد که او دور از برادران دیگر می‌نشیند، از او پرسید: «تو برادر آن‌ها هستی»؟ گفت: «آری»، پرسید: «پس چرا از آن‌ها فاصله می‌گیری»؟ گفت: «چون آن‌ها برادر مرا از پدر و مادرم جدا کردند و سپس بازگشتند و ادّعا کردند که گرگ او را خورده است، بنابراین از آن به بعد من بر خود مقرّر کرده‌ام که تا وقتی زنده‌ام در کنار آن‌ها و با آن‌ها جمع نشوم». یوسف (علیه السلام) گفت: «آیا ازدواج کرده‌ای و فرزندی داری»؟ گفت: «آری من صاحب سه پسر هستم که نام یکی را گرگ، نام دیگری را پیراهن و نام سوّمی را خون گذاشته‌ام»، یوسف (علیه السلام) گفت: «این اسامی را از کجا آورده‌ای»؟! او گفت: «به این جهت این اسامی را بر پسران خود نهاده‌ام که هرگز برادرم را فراموش نکنم و هربار که یکی از آن‌ها را صدا می‌زنم به یاد برادرم می‌افتم». آن وقت یوسف (علیه السلام) سایر برادران را بیرون کرد و فقط بنیامین را نگه داشت و آنگاه به او گفت: «من برادر تو یوسف هستم، پس از هرچه پیش می‌آید، نگران نشو، من دوست دارم که تو را نزد خود نگاه دارم». بنیامین گفت: «آن‌ها هرگز مرا نزد تو نمی‌گذارند، چون پدرمان از آن‌ها پیمان محکم گرفته است که مرا نزد او بازگردانند»، یوسف (علیه السلام) گفت: «من حیله‌ای اندیشیده‌ام که تو را در جریان آن قرار می‌دهم، ولی تو چیزی به آن‌ها نگو».
69.en: They departed, and Benjamin went with them. He would not eat with them, nor sit with them, nor speak to them. When they arrived in Egypt, they entered upon Joseph (peace be upon him) and greeted him. Joseph (peace be upon him) looked at his brother and recognized him, while he [Benjamin] sat apart from them. Joseph (peace be upon him) asked, "Are you their brother?" He replied, "Yes." He asked, "Why do you not sit with them?" He said, "Because they took away my brother, who was from my father and mother, then returned and claimed that a wolf had eaten him. Therefore, I have vowed to myself that I will never join them in any matter as long as I live." He [Joseph] asked, "Have you married?" He said, "Yes." He asked, "Have you had children?" He said, "Yes." He asked, "How many children do you have?" He said, "Three sons." He asked, "What have you named them?" He said, "I named one of them 'Wolf,' one 'Shirt,' and one 'Blood'." He asked, "How did you choose these names?" He said, "So that I would not forget my brother; every time I call one of my children, I remember my brother." Joseph (peace be upon him) said to them, "Leave," and he detained Benjamin. When they had left his presence, Joseph (peace be upon him) said to his brother, "I am your brother Joseph, so do not be distressed by what they used to do." Then he said to him, "I would like for you to stay with me." He replied, "My brothers will not let me, for my father took a covenant and a solemn oath from them that they would return me to him." He said, "I will devise a plan; do not object when you see something, and do not tell them." He said, "I will not."
69.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 114
69.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 238; Nur al-Thaqalayn

69.ar: وَ قَد کَانَ هَیَّأَ لَهُم طَعَاماً. فَلَمَّا دَخَلُوا عَلَیهِ، قَالَ لِیَجْلِسْ کُلُّ بَنِی أُمٍّ عَلَی مَائِدَةٍ فَجَلَسُوا وَ بَقِیَ بِنْیَامِینُ قَائِماً فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ مَا لَکَ لَمْ تَجْلِسْ فَقَالَ لَیْسَ لِی فِیهِمْ ابْنُ أُمٍّ فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ فَمَا کَانَ لَکَ ابْنُ أُمٍّ فَقَالَ بِنْیَامِینُ بَلَی وَ لَکِنْ زَعَمَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَکَلَهُ قَالَ فَمَا بَلَغَ مِنْ حُزْنِکَ عَلَیْهِ قَالَ وُلِدَ لِی اثْنَا عَشَرَ ابْناً کُلُّهُمُ أَشْتَقُّ لَهُمْ اسْماً مِنْ اسْمِهِ قَالَ یُوسُفُ أَرَاکَ قَدْ عَانَقْتَ النِّسَاءَ وَ شَمَمْتَ الْوَلَدَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ بِنْیَامِینُ إِنَّ لِی أَباً صَالِحاً وَ إِنَّهُ قَالَ لِی تَزَوَّجْ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ یُخْرِجُ مِنْکَ ذُرِّیَّةً تُثْقِلُ الْأَرْضَ بِالتَّسْبِیحِ فَقَالَ لَهُ یُوسُفُ فَاجْلِسْ عَلَی مَائِدَتِی فَقَالَ إِخْوَتُهُ قَدْ فَضَّلَ اللَّهُ یُوسُفَ وَ أَخَاهُ حَتَّی إِنَّ الْمَلِکَ قَدْ أَجْلَسَهُ مَعَهُ عَلَی مَائِدَتِهِ.
69.fa: یوسف (علیه السلام) برای برادرانش غذایی فراهم کرد. وقتی آنان در نزد او حاضر شدند، یوسف (علیه السلام) گفت: «کسانی که از طرف مادری با هم برادرند، بر سر یک سفره بنشینند». امام فرمود: «پس همه نشستند و فقط بنیامین، سر پا ایستاده بود». یوسف (علیه السلام) به او گفت: «تو چرا نمی‌نشینی»؟ بنیامین جواب داد: «شما گفتید آنان که از طرف مادر با هم برادرند سر یک سفره بنشینند و من در میان آنان، برادری از طرف مادر ندارم». یوسف (علیه السلام) گفت: «تو از طرف مادر، برادری نداشته‌ای»؟ بنیامین به او گفت: «چرا»! یوسف (علیه السلام) گفت: «چه به سرش آمده است»؟ بنیامین گفت: «اینان می‌پندارند که گرگ او را خورده است». یوسف (علیه السلام) از بنیامین پرسید: «تا چه اندازه از فقدان برادرت ناراحت هستی»؟ بنیامین گفت: «صاحب یازده پسر شده‌ام و نام تک‌تک آنان را از نام یوسف (علیه السلام) گرفته‌ام». یوسف (علیه السلام) به او گفت: «ولی می‌بینم که زنان را در آغوش کشیده و صاحب فرزندان زیادی شده‌ای»! بنیامین پاسخ داد: «پدری صالح و نیکوکار دارم که به من گفت: «ازدواج کن و همسر گزین که امید است خداوند متعال، فرزندانی به تو بدهد که با تنزیه و تسبیح خدای متعال، زمین را پر کنند». یوسف (علیه السلام) به بنیامین گفت: «بیا و با من بر سر سفره بنشین». برادران یوسف (علیه السلام) گفتند: «خداوند، یوسف (علیه السلام) و برادرش را برتری داده است؛ نگاه کنید، حتّی شاه مصر نیز بنیامین را بر سر سفره‌ی خود نشاند».
69.en: Joseph (peace be upon him) had prepared food for them. When they entered upon him, he said, "Let every brother who shares the same mother sit at a table together." They sat down, but Benjamin remained standing. Joseph said to him, "Why do you not sit?" He replied, "I have no brother among them who shares my mother." Joseph said to him, "Did you not have a brother who shared your mother?" Benjamin replied, "Yes, but these people claim that a wolf ate him." Joseph asked, "How great is your grief for him?" He replied, "I have had twelve sons, and I have derived the name of each one of them from his name." Joseph said, "I see that you have embraced women and fathered children after him." Benjamin replied, "I have a righteous father, and he said to me, 'Marry, for perhaps Allah the Almighty will bring forth from you a progeny that will weigh down the earth with the glorification of Allah.'" Joseph then said to him, "Then sit at my table." His brothers said, "Allah has favored Joseph and his brother, to the extent that even the King has seated him with him at his table."
69.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 114

69.ar: عَنْ أَبَانٍ الْأَحْمَرِ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: لَمَّا دَخَلَ إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ عَلَیْهِ وَ قَدْ جَاءُوا بِأَخِیهِمْ مَعَهُمْ وَضَعَ لَهُمُ الْمَوَائِدَ قَالَ یَمْتَارُ کُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْکُمْ مَعَ أَخِیهِ لِأُمِّ-هِ عَلَی الْخِوَانِ فَجَلَسُوا وَ بَقِیَ أَخُوهُ قَائِماً فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا لَکَ لَا تَجْلِسُ مَعَ إِخْوَتِکَ قَالَ لَیْسَ لِی مِنْهُمْ أَخٌ مِنْ أُمِّی قَالَ فَلَکَ أَخٌ مِنْ أُمِّکَ زَعَمَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَکَلَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَاقْعُدْ وَ کُلْ مَعِی قَالَ فَتَرَکَ إِخْوَتُهُ الْأَکْلَ قَالُوا إِنَّا نُرِیدُ أَمْراً وَ یَأْبَی اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ یَرْفَعَ وَلَدَ یَامِینَ عَلَیْنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ حِینَ فَرَغُوا مِنْ جِهَازِهِمْ أَمَرَ أَنْ یَضَعَ الصَّاعَ فِی رَحْلِ أَخِیهِ فَلَمَّا فَصَلُوا نَادَی مُنَادٍ أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ قَالَ فَرَجَعُوا فَقَالُوا ما ذا تَفْقِدُونَ قالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُواعَ الْمَلِکِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ جَزاؤُهُ مَنْ وُجِدَ فِی رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزاؤُهُ یَعْنُونَ السُّنَّةَ الَّتِی تَجْرِی فِیهِمْ أَنْ یَحْبِسَهُ فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِیَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعاءِ أَخِیهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَها مِنْ وِعاءِ أَخِیهِ {فَ} قالُوا إِنْ یَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
69.en: Aban al-Ahmar narrates from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: When the brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) entered upon him, and they had brought their brother with them, he set tables for them and said, "Let every two of you who share the same mother sit together at the table." They sat down, but his brother remained standing. Yusuf said to him, "Why do you not sit with your brothers?" He replied, "I have no brother among them from my mother." Yusuf asked, "Do you have a brother from your mother whom these people claim was eaten by a wolf?" He said, "Yes." Yusuf said, "Then sit and eat with me." His brothers stopped eating and said, "We intend one thing, but Allah refuses except to elevate the son of Yamin above us." Then, when they had finished preparing their provisions, he ordered that the measuring cup be placed in his brother's saddlebag. When they had departed, a herald called out, "O caravan, you are indeed thieves!" They returned and asked, "What is it that you have lost?" They replied, "We have lost the King's measuring cup." [The text continues to] His statement: "The penalty for it is [that] he in whose bag it is found, he is the penalty for it," meaning the law that was practiced among them, which was that he would be detained. He began with their bags before the bag of his brother, then he extracted it from his brother's bag. They said, "If he steals, a brother of his has stolen before."
69.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 114
69.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 307; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan (noting: "fasalu" [departed] is used instead of "fa'alu" [did]).

70.ar: فَلَمَّا جَهَّزَهُمْ بِجَهازِهِمْ وَ أَعْطَاهُمْ وَ أَحْسَنَ إِلَیْهِمْ قَالَ لِبَعْضِ قُوَّامِهِ اجْعَلُوا هَذَا الصَّاعَ فِی رَحْلِ هَذَا وَ کَانَ الصَّاعُ الَّذِی یَکِیلُونَ بِهِ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَجَعَلُوهُ فِی رَحْلِهِ مِنْ حَیْثُ لَمْ یَقِفُوا عَلَیْهِ إِخْوَتُهُ فَلَمَّا ارْتَحَلُوا بَعَثَ إِلَیْهِمْ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) وَ حَبَسَهُمْ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ مُنَادِیاً یُنَادِی أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ.
70.fa: کاروان فرزندان یعقوب آماده‌ی حرکت بود که یوسف (علیه السلام) به یکی از خواجگان خویش دستور داد تا پیمانه‌ی غلّه‌ی پادشاهی را که از جنس طلا بود پنهانی در میان اثاثیه‌ی بنیامین جا دهد لحظه‌ای که فرزندان یعقوب (علیه السلام) قصد خروج از نزد یوسف (علیه السلام) را داشتند فریاد کسی را شنیدند که می‌گفت: «ای کاروانیان شما متّهم به سرقت هستید، أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُون».
70.en: When he had provided them with their provisions, gave to them, and treated them kindly, he said to one of his stewards, "Place this measuring cup in the saddlebag of this one." The measuring cup with which they measured was made of gold. They placed it in his saddlebag without his brothers noticing. When they departed, Yusuf (peace be upon him) sent for them and detained them. Then he ordered a herald to call out, "O caravan, you are indeed thieves."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 116

70.ar: لَمَّا دَخَلَ إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) عَلَیْهِ وَ قَدْ جَاءُوا بِأَخِیهِمْ مَعَهُمْ وَضَعَ لَهُمُ الْمَوَائِدَ قَالَ یَمْتَارُ کُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْکُمْ مَعَ أَخِیهِ لِأُمِّهِ عَلَی الْخِوَانِ فَجَلَسُوا وَ بَقِیَ أَخُوهُ قَائِماً فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا لَکَ لَا تَجْلِسُ مَعَ إِخْوَتِکَ قَالَ لَیْسَ لِی مِنْهُمْ أَخٌ مِنْ أُمِّی قَالَ فَلَکَ أَخٌ مِنْ أُمِّکَ زَعَمَ هَؤُلَاءِ أَنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَکَلَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَاقْعُدْ وَ کُلْ مَعِی قَالَ فَتَرَکَ إِخْوَتُهُ الْأَکْلَ قَالُوا إِنَّا نُرِیدُ أَمْراً وَ یَأْبَی اللَّهُ إِلَّا أَنْ یَرْفَعَ وَلَدَ یَامِینَ عَلَیْنَا ثُمَّ قَالَ حِینَ فَرَغُوا مِنْ جِهَازِهِمْ أَمَرَ أَنْ یَضَعَ الصَّاعَ فِی رَحْلِ أَخِیهِ فَلَمَّا فَصَلُوا نَادَی مُنَادٍ أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ قَالَ فَرَجَعُوا فَقَالُوا ما ذا تَفْقِدُونَ قالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُواعَ الْمَلِکِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ جَزاؤُهُ مَنْ وُجِدَ فِی رَحْلِهِ فَهُوَ جَزاؤُهُ یَعْنُونَ السُّنَّةَ الَّتِی تَجْرِی فِیهِمْ أَنْ یَحْبِسَهُ فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِیَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعاءِ أَخِیهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَخْرَجَها مِنْ وِعاءِ أَخِیهِ فَقالُوا إِنْ یَسْرِقْ فَقَدْ سَرَقَ أَخٌ لَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
70.en: When the brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) entered upon him, having brought their brother with them, he set out tables for them and said, "Let each one of you sit at the table with his brother by the same mother." They sat down, but his brother remained standing. Yusuf said to him, "Why do you not sit with your brothers?" He replied, "I have no brother among them from my mother." Yusuf said, "Do you have a brother from your mother whom these people claim the wolf ate?" He said, "Yes." Yusuf said, "Then sit and eat with me." The brothers stopped eating and said, "We intend one thing, but Allah refuses except to elevate the son of Yamin above us." Then, when they had finished preparing their provisions, he ordered that the measuring cup be placed in his brother's saddlebag. When they had departed, a caller cried out, "O caravan, you are indeed thieves!" They returned and said, "What is it that you have lost?" They said, "We have lost the King's measuring cup." [Referring to the verse:] "The penalty for it is that he in whose saddlebag it is found, he is the penalty for it." They meant the custom that was practiced among them, that he [the thief] would be detained by him. He began with their bags before the bag of his brother, then he extracted it from his brother's bag. They said, "If he steals, a brother of his has stolen before him."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 116
70.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 307; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 183

70.ar: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الصَّیْقَلِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) إِنَّا قَدْ رُوِّینَا عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ فَقَالَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا سَرَقُوا وَ مَا کَذَبَ وَ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِیمُ (علیه السلام) بَلْ فَعَلَهُ کَبِیرُهُمْ هذا فَسْئَلُوهُمْ إِنْ کانُوا یَنْطِقُونَ فَقَالَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا فَعَلُوا وَ مَا کَذَبَ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُوعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) مَا عِنْدَکُمْ فِیهَا یَا صَیْقَلُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ مَا عِنْدَنَا فِیهَا إِلَّا التَّسْلِیمُ قَالَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَحَبَّ اثْنَیْنِ وَ أَبْغَضَ اثْنَیْنِ أَحَبَّ الْخَطَرَ فِیمَا بَیْنَ الصَّفَّیْنِ وَ أَحَبَّ الْکَذِبَ فِی الْإِصْلَاحِ وَ أَبْغَضَ الْخَطَرَ فِی الطُّرُقَاتِ وَ أَبْغَضَ الْکَذِبَ فِی غَیْرِ الْإِصْلَاحِ إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (علیه السلام) إِنَّمَا قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ کَبِیرُهُمْ هذا إِرَادَة َ الْإِصْلَاحِ وَ دَلَالَةً عَلَی أَنَّهُمْ لَا یَفْعَلُونَ وَ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) إِرَادَةَ الْإِصْلَاحِ.
70.en: Hasan al-Sayqal said: I said to Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him), "We have narrated from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding the statement of Yusuf (peace be upon him), 'O caravan, you are indeed thieves' (12:70), that he said: 'By Allah, they did not steal, and he did not lie.' And Ibrahim (peace be upon him) said, 'Rather, it was this, the largest of them, who did it, so ask them if they can speak' (21:63), and he said: 'By Allah, they did not do it, and he did not lie.'" Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) then said, "What is your view on this, O Sayqal?" I said, "We have no view on this except submission." He said, "Verily, Allah loves two things and hates two things: He loves pride [in the form of bold strides] between two battle lines, and He loves lying for the sake of reconciliation; and He hates pride in the streets, and He hates lying that is not for the sake of reconciliation. Ibrahim (peace be upon him) only said, 'Rather, it was this, the largest of them, who did it,' intending reconciliation and as a demonstration that they [the idols] do not act. And Yusuf (peace be upon him) said [what he said] intending reconciliation."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 118
70.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 2, p. 341; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 55 (with "ya'qilun" instead of "yaf'alun"); Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 12, p. 253; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

70.ar: عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله): لَا کَذَبَ عَلَی مُصْلِحٍ ثُمَّ تَلَا أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا سَرَقُوا وَ مَا کَذَب.
70.fa: از امام صادق (علیه السلام) روایت است که پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) فرمود: اصلاح‌گر، هیچ‌وقت دروغگو نیست. سپس آیه: أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ را تلاوت کرده و فرمود: «به خدا قسم آنان دزدی نکردند و یوسف (علیه السلام) هم دروغ نگفت».
70.en: It is narrated from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "There is no lying for a peacemaker." He then recited: "O caravan, indeed you are thieves," and added: "By Allah, they did not steal, and he [Yusuf] did not lie."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 118
70.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 2, p. 343; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 252; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Jaza'iri, p. 112; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 12, p. 254; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

70.ar: الْکَلَامُ ثَلَاثَةٌ: صِدْقٌ، وَ کَذِبٌ، وَ إِصْلَاحٌ بَیْنَ النَّاس.
70.fa: سخن بر سه‌گونه است؛ راست، دروغ و یا اصلاح بین مردم.
70.en: Speech is of three types: truth, falsehood, and reconciliation between people.
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 118
70.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 69, p. 251; Nur al-Thaqalayn

70.ar: عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ سَعِیدٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَال: سَأَلْتُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ فِی یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ قَالَ إِنَّهُمْ سَرَقُوا یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) مِنْ أَبِیهِ أَ لَا تَرَی أَنَّهُ قَالَ لَهُمْ حِینَ قَالُوا ما ذا تَفْقِدُونَ قالُوا نَفْقِدُ صُواعَ الْمَلِکِ وَ لَمْ یَقُولُوا سَرَقْتُمْ صُوَاعَ الْمَلِکِ إِنَّمَا عَنَی أَنَّکُمْ سَرَقْتُمْ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) عَنْ أَبِیهِ.
70.fa: صالح‌بن‌سعید از مردی از شیعیان ما نقل می‌کند که از امام صادق (علیه السلام) و در مورد آیه: أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ در سوره‌ی یوسف را از امام صادق (علیه السلام) پرسیدم. امام فرمود: «آنان یوسف (علیه السلام) را از پدر دزدیدند، مگر ندیدی وقتی کاروانیان و برادران یوسف (علیه السلام) با صدای منادی، برگشته و به سوی او روی آوردند و از منادی پرسیدند: ماذا تَفْقِدُونَ آنان گفتند: نَفْقِدُ صُواعَ الْملِکِ و نگفتند: شما کاروانیان دزد هستید. بنابراین در اینجا نیز مقصود، این است که شما یوسف (علیه السلام) را از پدرش دزدیدید.
70.en: Salih ibn Sa'id narrates from a man among our companions that he asked Abu 'Abd Allah (peace be upon him) regarding the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, concerning Yusuf (peace be upon him): "O caravan! You are surely thieves" (12:70). He said: "They had stolen Yusuf (peace be upon him) from his father. Do you not see that when they said, 'What is it that you miss?' they replied, 'We miss the king's measuring cup,' and they did not say, 'You have stolen the king's measuring cup.' He only meant that you stole Yusuf (peace be upon him) from his father."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 118
70.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 278; al-Ihtijaj, Vol. 2, p. 354; al-'Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 185; al-Qummi, Vol. 1, p. 349; 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 1, p. 52; al-Burhan

70.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُوعَبْدِاللَّهِ (علیه السلام) التَّقِیَّةُ مِنْ دِینِ اللَّهِ قُلْتُ مِنْ دِینِ اللَّهِ قَالَ إِی وَ اللَّهِ مِنْ دِینِ اللَّهِ وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا کَانُوا سَرَقُوا شَیْئاً.
70.fa: ابوبصیر گوید: امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: «تقیّه، جزئی از دین خداست». عرض کردم: «جزئی از دین خداست»؟ امام فرمود: «آری، به خدا قسم! جزئی از دین خداست؛ یوسف (علیه السلام) گفته است: أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ سپس فرمود: به خدا قسم، چیزی را ندزدیده بودند».
70.en: Abu Basir narrated: Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said, "Taqiyya (pious dissimulation) is part of the religion of Allah." I asked, "Part of the religion of Allah?" He replied, "Yes, by Allah, it is part of the religion of Allah. Yusuf (peace be upon him) said: 'O caravan! You are surely thieves' (12:70), and by Allah, they had not stolen anything."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 120
70.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 2, p. 217; Wasa'il al-Shi'a, Vol. 16, p. 209; Wasa'il al-Shi'a, Vol. 16, p. 215; al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 184; 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 1, p. 51; al-Mahasin, Vol. 1, p. 258; Mishkat al-Anwar, p. 43; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

70.ar: لَا خَیْرَ فِیمَنْ لَا تَقِیَّةَ لَهُ وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ وَ مَا سَرَقُوا.
70.fa: آن‌کس که تقیّه ندارد، هیچ خیر و برکتی در او نیست. این یوسف (علیه السلام) است که فرموده أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسَارِقُونَ درحالی‌که آنان چیزی را ندزدیده بودند.
70.en: There is no good in one who does not practice taqiyya (dissimulation). Indeed, Yusuf (peace be upon him) said, "O caravan, you are surely thieves," when they had not stolen anything.
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 120
70.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 308; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 12, p. 278; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 184; 'Ilal al-Shara'i', Vol. 1, p. 51; Wasa'il al-Shi'a, Vol. 16, p. 208; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 12, p. 254; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

70.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَصِیرٍ قَالَ: قِیلَ لِأَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ إِنَّ سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِی حَفْصَةَ وَ أَصْحَابَهُ یَرْوُونَ عَنْکَ أَنَّکَ تَکَلَّمُ عَلَی سَبْعِینَ وَجْهاً لَکَ مِنْهَا الْمَخْرَجُ فَقَالَ مَا یُرِیدُ سَالِمٌ مِنِّی أَ یُرِیدُ أَنْ أَجِیءَ بِالْمَلَائِکَةِ وَ اللَّهِ مَا جَاءَتْ بِهَذَا النَّبِیُّونَ وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِیمُ (علیه السلام) إِنِّی سَقِیمٌ وَ مَا کَانَ سَقِیماً وَ مَا کَذَبَ وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِیمُ (علیه السلام) بَلْ فَعَلَهُ کَبِیرُهُمْ هذا وَ مَا فَعَلَهُ وَ مَا کَذَبَ وَ لَقَدْ قَالَ یُوسُفُ (علیه السلام) أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ إِنَّکُمْ لَسارِقُونَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا کَانُوا سَارِقِینَ وَ مَا کَذَبَ.
70.en: Abu Basir reported: It was said to Abu Ja‘far (peace be upon him) while I was with him, "Salim ibn Abi Hafsah and his companions narrate from you that you speak in seventy ways, and that you have a way out (a justification) for each of them." He replied, "What does Salim want from me? Does he want me to bring the angels? By Allah, the prophets did not bring them. Abraham (peace be upon him) said, 'Indeed, I am ill' (Saffat/89), and he was not ill, yet he did not lie. Abraham (peace be upon him) also said, 'Rather, it was this, the largest of them, who did it' (Anbiya/63), and he did not do it, yet he did not lie. And Joseph (peace be upon him) said, 'O caravan, indeed you are thieves' (Yusuf/70), and by Allah, they were not thieves, yet he did not lie."
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 120
70.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 100; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 2, p. 206; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 2, p. 209; Al-Ayyashi, Vol. 2, p. 184; Rijal al-Kashshi, p. 234; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 12, p. 255; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan.

70.ar: أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ مَعْنَاهُ یَا أَهْلَ الْعِیرِ.
70.fa: أَیَّتُهَا الْعِیرُ یعنی ای اهل کاروان!
70.en: "Ayyatuha al-ʿir" (O caravan!) means: O people of the caravan!
70.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 120

71.ar: فَقَالَ إِخْوَةُ یُوسُفَ (علیه السلام) ماذا تَفْقِدُون.
71.fa: برادران یوسف (علیه السلام) گفتند: «چه چیز گم کرده‌اید»؟
71.en: The brothers of Yusuf (peace be upon him) said, "What is it that you have lost?"
71.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 7, p. 120

73.ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِی حَمْزَةَ عَمَّنْ ذَکَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِاللَّهِ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِه صُواعَ الْمَلِکِ قَالَ کَانَ قَدَحاً مِنْ ذَهَبٍ وَ قَالَ کَانَ صُوَاعَ یُوسُفَ إِذْ کِیْلَ بِه قَالَ: لَعَنَ اللهُ الْخَّوانَ لَا تَخُونُوا بِهِ بِصَوْتٍ حَسَنٍ.
73.fa: محمّدبن‌ابی‌حمزه از کسی که از امام صادق (علیه السلام) ذکر کرده، نقل می‌کند که امام (علیه السلام) در توضیح عبارت: صُوَاعَ المَلِکِ فرمود: «صُوَاعَ پیاله‌ای طلایی بود. وقتی یوسف (علیه السلام) چیزی را با آن وزن و پیمانه می‌کرد، با صدایی رسا و خوب می‌گفت: خداوند، خیانتکاران را لعنت کند، با پیمانه به بندگان خدا خیانت نکنید».
